title: Fourier extensions for matrix-function block encodings with error-independent subnormalization bounds
summary: Block encodings of non-unitary matrix functions are central to quantum numerical linear algebra. Hamiltonian simulation is a natural input model for Hermitian matrices, but accurate block encodings often incur large subnormalization. We decouple the accuracy from the subnormalization by formulating the matrix-function block encoding as a Fourier-extension approximation problem, yielding a linear combination of unitaries for Hermitian matrix inputs.
